The 'drift' theta is exactly 2pi*77/1000, so it is a 1000-periodic kernel (case (c), constant fold at modulus 13), not a T5 instance; 'near' (sqrt2 perturbation) and 'irrational' are genuine (d) instances. At finite i all three are still partly comb-like (near-resonance window ~ 1/|theta-2pi/13| ~ 1e3 steps).
